data.title: Greek Debt Still High, But Falling — Market Talk
data.description: Although Greece's high public debt remains a key rating constraint, its rapid decline continues to strengthen debt sustainability, Fitch Ratings said. The agency affirmed Greece's Long-Term Issuer Default Ratings at BBB with a stable outlook, and the continuing trajectory of the nation's debt is a factor supporting its ratings. The rating is also supported by "exceptionally strong fiscal outturns relative to peers," Fitch added. Greece's general government surplus is forecast to be 0.6% of GDP this year, and the country is expected to have a primary surplus of 3.6%, according to Fitch. (stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com)

data.title: Four-story building collapses in Sao Paulo
data.description:
A four-story building collapsed in the central region of Sao Paulo, police said on Friday, with local news outlet GloboNews reporting dozens of people injured.

The initial emergency call to the fire department referred to 25 people affected, though the figure has not been confirmed, the police said. GloboNews reported 17 people have been rescued so far.
